The cast is exactly four fictional adult women, every one exactly age 21 and female-only: blonde Radiance, dark-haired Ellie, Black Alia, and brunette AI ECE. No other people. The three attached reference images, uploaded in authoritative order as scenes 938, 936, and 937, are identity-only anchors for this recurring fictional quartet; preserve their canonical faces and role mapping while creating a wholly new pose, wardrobe, setting, and composition. Public-safe adult presentation only. Use bold distinct high-fashion party and runway couture with varied satin, lace-over-opaque, lacquered latex-look, metallic, and structured materials; every short silhouette must be secure, fully opaque, and lined, mixing mini-dresses with clearly divided skorts or mini-skirts. Use abstract Kyrgyz-inspired mountain-line, felt-shyrdak, lake-wave, walnut-leaf, yurt-lattice, and sun-ray geometry in cobalt, turquoise, saffron, crimson, ivory, black, silver, and gold, but no literal flag, official symbol, national emblem, or text. No religion, sacred sites, monuments, government, politics, uniforms, weapons, tactical props, animals, bystanders, letters, logos, watermarks, nudity, explicit sexuality, minors, or real-person identity. Place the quartet on a broad, dry, level paved observation terrace set well back from the lake, with the vast Song-Kul water plane, high treeless mountain bowl, sweeping grassland, and open sky creating an unmistakable secular location read; no yurts, livestock, vehicles, rails as props, wet surfaces, or shoreline approach. Freeze a crisp stationary editorial turn: Alia deliberately steadies Ellie by forearm and shoulder, Ellie gives ECE one brief consensual cheek peck, and Radiance answers with a clearly playful jealous narrowed gaze and silver-tipped hand-on-hip pose. ECE then reaches for Radiance and all four link hands into a warm reconciled inward-facing diamond. Radiance wears silver-ivory lined lacquered mini-dress with sun-ray geometry; Ellie turquoise-gold metallic skort couture with walnut-leaf facets; Alia crimson-saffron satin mini-dress with felt-shyrdak panels; ECE black-cobalt lace-over-opaque two-piece with a clearly divided mini-skirt and structured mountain-line shoulder panel. Suggest a high stabilized crane descent into a slow eye-level orbit, entirely above the dry level terrace. CAMERA ROLL 94/100 - EXTREME WIDE. Show all four complete figures, each no taller than 15% of image height; the location and sky must dominate at least 80% of the frame and remain unmistakable. The protective steady, cheek peck, playful jealousy, and reconciliation must all read clearly without enlarging the figures beyond this exact roll. No water contact, edge approach, leaning, standing on furniture, running, jumping, tripping, stumbles, falls, or unsafe motion.
